topic: Recalculating campaign report and dwell time
summary_markdown: The new report was placed on staging, requiring a recalculation of the campaign to regenerate it. After initial testing, one participant confirmed that Frame Reach looked good but noted that Dwell Time data was missing for many screens.
decisions: Campaign needs recalculating to generate the final report.
action_items: Investigate and address missing Dwell Time data across multiple screens.
